title: Schalke relegated from Bundesliga: A Royal Case of the Blues
content: # Schalke relegated from Bundesliga: A Royal Case of the Blues. Schalke have been relegated from the Bundesliga. It's a story of sporting failure, mismanagement, pandemic-related scandal and the power of one man. With over 160,000 members, Schalke 04 are the second-biggest football club in Germany, seven times German champions and one of the biggest names in world football. But now, for the first time in 33 years, the *Königsblauen* (Royal Blues) have been relegated to the second division. It's a journey which has left Schalke with €217 million ($257.8 million) of debt, an inexperienced coach, a squad unfit for the second division, a supervisory board divided in acrimony, a thoroughly disillusioned fanbase and a list of intrigues to rival any Netflix drama. But, for Kornelia Toporzysek, a lifelong Schalke supporter, lawyer and former member of the club's honorary board, it was August 7, 2019, the day on which her fellow board members acquitted Clemens Tönnies of racism.
